prints.text: Reported in chat, not on the review page: printed the bistable_coupon and it failed. The left and right hand brackets must be connected, and the switch arms have to pass through a hole that tunnels through the frame. Cause: build 20260910-214446 cut the plunger slots clean through both rails, so the frame was two separate side brackets joined only by the living hinges. Material not stated; a frame design failure, not evidence about the mechanism or its hinges.

Reported in chat, not on the review page: printed the redesigned coupon (build 20260910-232439, closed frame with plunger tunnels) in PLA because no PETG was on hand, and it works really well. The user did not say which hinge width was printed; both parts are listed. Confirms the estimated 37 mm span and 8 deg pre-tilt snap in PLA. Long-term creep when parked in one state is still unobserved.
